text_segments.text: {% set fl = exif.FocalLengthIn35mmFormat|default('', true)|replace(' ', '') %}{% set aper = exif.AperatureValue or exif.FNumber or '' %}{% set shutter = exif.ShutterSpeed or exif.ShutterSpeedValue or '' %}{% set iso = exif.ISO|default('', true) %}{{ [fl, ('f/' ~ aper) if aper else '', (shutter ~ 's') if shutter else '', ('ISO ' ~ iso) if iso else '']|reject('equalto', '')|join('  ') }}
